captions.text: Kusari puts owner-controlled limits around AI trading agents.
lines: Kusari puts owner-controlled limits around AI trading agents.

captions.text: The vault holds test funds. The policy sets the agent's limits.
lines: The vault holds test funds. The policy sets the agent's limits.

captions.text: For this repeatable test, request exactly 2 kUSD under a 5 kUSD cap.
lines: For this repeatable test, request exactly 2 kUSD under a 5 kUSD cap.

captions.text: The swap succeeds. The transaction link opens its public Sepolia receipt.
lines: The swap succeeds. The transaction link opens its public Sepolia receipt.

captions.text: The owner changes the ENS per-trade cap from 5 to 1 kUSD in one transaction.
lines: The owner changes the ENS per-trade cap from 5 to 1 kUSD in one transaction.

captions.text: The ENS update is confirmed. No application or contract was redeployed.
lines: The ENS update is confirmed. No application or contract was redeployed.

captions.text: Repeat the same 2 kUSD request. The hook reads the new 1 kUSD limit.
lines: Repeat the same 2 kUSD request. The hook reads the new 1 kUSD limit.

captions.text: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported ExceedsPerSwap. The request stayed the same; ENS changed.
lines: The receipt confirms a revert. Simulation reported ExceedsPerSwap. The request stayed the same; ENS
changed.

captions.text: Restore the ENS cap to 5 kUSD before testing authorization separately.
lines: Restore the ENS cap to 5 kUSD before testing authorization separately.

captions.text: Cap 5 is restored. The owner can also revoke the agent's authority.
lines: Cap 5 is restored. The owner can also revoke the agent's authority.

captions.text: Freeze agent revokes its ENS role in one owner-approved Sepolia transaction.
lines: Freeze agent revokes its ENS role in one owner-approved Sepolia transaction.

captions.text: Revocation is confirmed. Trading is blocked even though funds and the spending cap remain.
lines: Revocation is confirmed. Trading is blocked even though funds and the spending cap remain.

captions.text: Request 2 kUSD again. That amount is within cap 5, but the agent is no longer authorized.
lines: Request 2 kUSD again. That amount is within cap 5, but the agent is no longer authorized.

captions.text: The receipt confirms another revert. Simulation reported NotAuthorized. A valid agent signature cannot override revocation.
lines: The receipt confirms another revert. Simulation reported NotAuthorized. A valid agent signature cannot
override revocation.

captions.text: The owner restores the ENS role. The agent cannot give itself that permission.
lines: The owner restores the ENS role. The agent cannot give itself that permission.

captions.text: Authorization is restored. The same vault and Uniswap hook remain in place.
lines: Authorization is restored. The same vault and Uniswap hook remain in place.

captions.text: The previous requests were fixed policy tests. Now run the real Gemini agent.
lines: The previous requests were fixed policy tests. Now run the real Gemini agent.

captions.text: Gemini reads news and chain state, then chooses a 1 kUSD trade within the public demo's ceiling.
lines: Gemini reads news and chain state, then chooses a 1 kUSD trade within the public demo's ceiling.

captions.text: Gemini's trade succeeds after restoration. The result shows the requested amount, owner limit, outcome and receipt.
lines: Gemini's trade succeeds after restoration. The result shows the requested amount, owner limit, outcome and
receipt.

captions.text: The hook checks actual swap output and pool-price movement. Anon-RPC with Nox carries agent RPC traffic; transactions remain public.
lines: The hook checks actual swap output and pool-price movement. Anon-RPC with Nox carries agent RPC traffic;
transactions remain public.

captions.text: AI proposes. ENS supplies authority. Uniswap enforces the boundary. Verify the code and receipts.
lines: AI proposes. ENS supplies authority. Uniswap enforces the boundary. Verify the code and receipts.
